$comment: Where the engine's name may appear, with the reason (own-harness D2). Read by runtime/scripts/check-brand.mjs. `path` is a file, a folder (trailing slash) or a glob (`*` within a segment, `**` across); `rules` are the lint rules the entry exempts; `match` (a regex) narrows an entry to the hits whose text matches, and the brand word must sit inside the matched part. An entry that matches nothing is reported as stale, and test/check-brand.test.mjs fails on it: rewording an allowed line means updating its entry. Everything not listed here is a baseline hit that a plan part removes.
